es.back_translation: The air quality is not healthy from fire smoke today Friday and tomorrow Saturday, with air quality index up to 165. Stay inside the house with the windows closed and avoid heavy work outdoors. If you must go out, wear a well-fitted N95 mask.

vi.back_translation: Today (Friday) and tomorrow (Saturday), wildfire smoke makes the air harmful to health (AQI index up to 165). Stay inside the house and close windows tightly. Avoid heavy work outdoors. If you must go outside, wear a close-fitting N95 mask.

sent.en: Hurricane Watch is in effect until Sunday afternoon for coastal Miami-Dade. Hurricane conditions are possible within 48 hours starting today. Prepare now, secure outdoor items and supplies, and follow instructions from local officials.

messages.en: Hurricane Watch is in effect until Sunday afternoon for coastal Miami-Dade. Hurricane conditions are possible within 48 hours starting today. Prepare now, secure outdoor items and supplies, and follow instructions from local officials.
messages.es: Vigilancia de huracán vigente hasta el domingo en la tarde para la costa de Miami-Dade. Condiciones de huracán son posibles en las próximas 48 horas a partir de hoy. Prepárese ahora, asegure objetos al aire libre y provisiones, y siga las instrucciones de las autoridades locales.
messages.vi: Cảnh giác bão cuồng phong có hiệu lực đến chiều Chủ Nhật cho khu vực ven biển Miami-Dade. Điều kiện bão cuồng phong có thể xảy ra trong 48 giờ tới kể từ hôm nay. Hãy chuẩn bị ngay, cố định đồ đạc ngoài trời và nhu yếu phẩm, và làm theo hướng dẫn của chính quyền địa phương.

es.back_translation: Hurricane Watch in effect until Sunday in the afternoon for the coast of Miami-Dade. Hurricane conditions are possible in the next 48 hours starting today. Prepare now, secure outdoor objects and supplies, and follow the instructions of the local authorities.

vi.back_translation: Hurricane vigilance in effect until Sunday afternoon for the coastal area of Miami-Dade. Hurricane conditions can occur in the next 48 hours from today. Prepare immediately, secure outdoor belongings and necessities, and follow instructions of the local government.
